name: Midou Takuya
source:
Jun's Kansai-accented sardonic best friend. Although he uses Kansai dialect, he wasn't born in Kansai. He tends to be bullied a lot by Jun. Midou helps Jun to become a qualified Trimmer. He takes the same course as Jun, but his goal isn't to become a Trimmer.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pure_Pure]Wikipedia[/url].]
